name: AWS (Bedrock, ECS, Lambda, RDS)
metaTitle: AWS Cloud and DevOps Services for AI Workloads
description: Techlio designs, deploys, and runs software and private AI systems on AWS: cloud architecture, CI/CD, serverless compute, observability, and FinOps cost control.
h1: AWS architecture and operations *for software and AI.*
answer: Amazon Web Services is the cloud platform most of Techlio's client systems run on. Techlio designs the architecture, automates releases, and operates applications and AI workloads on AWS, working inside the client's own account.

builds.title: Cloud architecture
builds.text: Secure, cost-aware designs using containers, serverless functions and managed databases.

builds.title: CI/CD and release automation
builds.text: Pipelines that test and deploy every change, with staged rollouts and rollback.

builds.title: AI workloads
builds.text: Model access, vector storage, background jobs and monitoring for AI features in production.

fits: You want infrastructure in an account you own and control
The system needs to scale with demand
Security reviews require clear access control, logging and encryption

faqs.question: Do you work in our AWS account?
faqs.answer: Yes. You keep ownership, billing and access.

faqs.question: Can you reduce our AWS bill?
faqs.answer: Usually. A review finds idle resources, oversized instances and missing caching.

faqs.question: Do you support other clouds?
faqs.answer: Yes, though most of our production work is on AWS.
